chose: A scene longer than 400 characters is said by home's speaker in parts of at most 400, split after a sentence (else between words), each given 4 minutes, and the parts' audio joined; a scene of one part is asked exactly as before, so its take and its kept copy are unchanged.
options: parts of at most 400 characters, 4 minutes each
one request a scene with a longer wait (a custom fetch dispatcher past undici's 300 s)
parts by sentence, one sentence a request
gray: A scene said in parts can sound slightly different at a part's seam than one said whole, which the owner hears in the video; a longer single wait keeps the voice as before but leaves a scene's wait unbounded by its length, and one sentence a request multiplies the speaker's calls.
undo: In speaker.ts, raise SPEAKER_CHUNK_CHARS past the speaker's 4,000-character limit, so every scene is one part.
